summary: Replace ceremonial human approval requirements with verifiable functional artifacts and independent agent review, while preserving explicit human authority for weakened guardrails, spending money, private-data exposure, and irreversible actions.
behavior_changes: GitHub CI and branch governance require the authoritative source-test and deterministic-release checks before main can advance.
Representative JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Python fixture projects prove setup and gate behavior across supported runner variants.
High-risk implementation hotspots gain characterization tests and smaller control-flow units without changing their public contracts.
The beta release includes deterministic portable artifacts, checksums, CycloneDX inventories, provenance, and verifiable signatures or attestations.
Dogfood evidence covers setup, CLI, review, dashboard, TUI, acceptance mutation, release, rollback, and clean-clone operation.

Oversized Python mutation scopes fail deterministically before execution, while bounded campaigns reserve separate execution, result-export, overhead, and safety budgets and preserve structured incomplete evidence.
Portable setup and upgrade create a protected executable ./aqg command while retaining python3 quality/qg.py as the cross-platform fallback.

Generated ignore rules cover Python interpreter, test, type-checker, linter, environment, and JavaScript dependency caches so invoking the installed gauntlet does not manufacture workspace-integrity failures.

Release payloads use Git-tracked runtime sources in the authoritative checkout, deterministic hidden-cache exclusion in isolated copies, and canonical GitHub origin spellings so transient state cannot change candidate bytes.

Release provenance accepts Git revision, remote, dirty-state, and commit-time metadata only when the release source root owns that repository; isolated copies fail closed to a local unversioned identity.
Manual hosted runs compare against the authoritative default branch, and release artifacts or attestations cannot proceed until the full test matrix and risk-selected policy evidence succeed.

Changed-only Python mutation maps changed executable lines to exact mutmut function selectors, enforces protected 80/90/95 percent selection-coverage floors by profile, filters unrelated repository mutants from scoring, and fails closed on empty or failed result collection.

Changed-code mutation counts executable additions and deletions, maps deletion-only edits to the surviving enclosing selector when possible, and fails closed when removed production behavior has no current selector to mutate.

Existing repositories can inventory inherited debt through a non-blocking shadow audit, establish a reviewed fingerprinted baseline, and block only new or worsened debt while adopting strict controls.
Retrospective reports distinguish inherited debt, regressions, missing evidence, configuration errors, infrastructure errors, and unknown product intent.
Each completed run snapshots detailed gate evidence into an immutable manifested run directory.
Authoritative CI grades candidates with a base-controlled or immutable grader rather than trusting candidate-controlled checking code.
Policy maintenance uses scoped fingerprinted evidence and independent agent review; weakening a guardrail still requires explicit human authority.
High-assurance work requires current executable behavior, functional QA, rollback rehearsal, trusted verification, and independent agent-review artifacts instead of ceremonial human approval files.
Owner status reports works, broken, not tested, unusable evidence, and human decision needed as distinct states without relabeling missing ceremony as a functional defect.
Release workflows may publish automatically after all deterministic release gates and required independent agent reviews pass, without a separate human release form.
All required test roots, requirement identifiers, semantic acceptance mutations, and stable repeated performance measurements are governed by executable contracts.
CLI, dashboard, TUI, reports, and CI summaries derive Develop, Merge, and Release guidance from one fail-closed owner-status model.

Owner status verifies run manifests and exact candidate fingerprints, distinguishes inherited debt from current regressions, and never promotes local evidence into external merge or release authority.

A multi-model review council runs isolated role-specific reviews through explicit provider adapters, preserves dissent and unknowns, and stores prompt, model, scope, and response provenance as immutable evidence.

Oversized council candidates use a content-addressed diff-only bundle series with repeated shared context, per-chunk quorum, conservative aggregation, exact reconstruction, and explicit cross-chunk visibility limitations.

Agent review remains advisory unless protected policy explicitly assigns it an assurance gate; even then it cannot override deterministic failures, missing product intent, or explicit human-authority boundaries.

A connected greenfield TypeScript, HTML, and CSS pilot proves installation, unit/property testing, structure, coverage, acceptance behavior, and generation of browser/accessibility wiring; live browser and mutation evidence remain separate explicit controls.
The development loop gains only conservative speedups whose selection and cache provenance are recorded and whose uncertainty falls back to the complete applicable suite.
behavior_preserved: Exit 0 means pass, exit 1 quality failure, exit 2 configuration failure, and exit 3 infrastructure failure.
Missing, stale, malformed, or untrustworthy evidence fails closed.
Existing JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Python adapter behavior remains supported.
Policy, expected-output, waiver, and authority-boundary changes remain protected and reviewable.
The source runtime remains dependency-free on Python 3.11 or newer.
Recovered baseline history and published main remain recoverable throughout the work.
The stop hook remains disabled until the fast profile is green, stable, and acceptably quick.
The existing 104-item inherited fast-baseline proposal remains unapproved and non-authoritative.
Agent review does not impersonate a human or hosted branch-protection rule.
Agents do not weaken guardrails, spend money, expose private data, or perform irreversible actions without explicit human authority.
failure_detection: Focused owner-status and council contract tests, malformed and stale evidence cases, provider timeout and schema-failure cases, fast and deep AQG profiles, changed-code mutation, a connected TypeScript/web pilot, browser accessibility smoke tests, deterministic builds, clean-clone dogfooding, GitHub required checks, and independent verification.
rollback: Revert granular commits or the productionization pull request; restore the prior main ruleset export; delete an unpublished draft release or supersede a published beta with the prior checksummed artifacts.
human_review: Any proposed weakening of a quality threshold, required gate, protected path, evidence rule, or test oracle
Any action that exposes private data
